name: Adaptive throttling (the caller rejects)
description: Same as "retry storm", with one more setting: every edge uses adaptive throttling (Google SRE, K = 2). The caller counts calls sent and successes over the last 10 s; when too few succeed, it rejects some calls locally and does not send them. After the spike the retry storm stops, and the system recovers after about 33 s. That is slower than the retry budget (about 3 s): the window still holds many failures, and enough successes must build up before all calls are let through. Try K = 1.5 (rejects earlier) or 3.
